fields.name: intensity
fields.tooltip: Master dial. 0 = off (the render pass is skipped entirely), 1 = the full fog and glitch below. Gameplay scales it further with DistanceFog.SetIntensity.

fields.name: fogStart
fields.tooltip: Distance the fog starts building at — everything closer is untouched.

fields.name: fogEnd
fields.tooltip: Distance the fog is solid at. Keep at or below the city's streamEnterDistance so the block pop-in happens inside the fog.

fields.name: fogDensity
fields.tooltip: Shape of the ramp between start and end (exponential-squared). Low = a slow build that is still see-through near the end; high = clear then a wall.

fields.name: fogColorNear
fields.tooltip: Fog colour where it begins. Keep the values below 1 unless the fog should bloom — the pass runs before post-processing.

fields.name: fogColorFar
fields.tooltip: Fog colour at the far end, also the colour dropped-out glitch blocks snap to.

fields.name: skyFogAmount
fields.tooltip: How much of the sky the far fog colour covers. 1 buries the skybox; lower keeps a horizon band visible.

fields.name: heightFog
fields.tooltip: Thin the fog with altitude, so rooftops and overpass decks stand out of a low-lying haze.

fields.name: heightFalloff
fields.tooltip: How fast the fog thins per metre above the base height.

fields.name: heightBase
fields.tooltip: World height the fog is full at; above it the falloff applies.

fields.name: farGlitch
fields.tooltip: Tear, drop out and colour-split the distant picture as it fogs — the far city dissolving into signal noise.

fields.name: glitchStart
fields.tooltip: Distance the glitch starts at; it reaches full strength at the fog end.

fields.name: glitchStrength
fields.tooltip: Overall glitch amount at the fog end.

fields.name: glitchRate
fields.tooltip: Corrupt frames per second — the glitch jumps between states at this rate rather than sliding.

fields.name: sliceStrength
fields.tooltip: How far torn rows shift sideways, as a fraction of the screen.

fields.name: blockAmount
fields.tooltip: How many distant macroblocks drop to the far fog colour — blocks that have not streamed in yet.

fields.name: colorSplit
fields.tooltip: Red/blue channel offset on the glitching band, as a fraction of the screen.

fields.name: scanlineStrength
fields.tooltip: Scanline darkening on the glitching band.

fields.name: clampFarClip
fields.tooltip: Pull the chase camera's far clip plane in to fog end + margin: nothing past the solid fog can be seen, so nothing past it needs culling or drawing. The biggest free win of the fog.

fields.name: farClipMargin
fields.tooltip: Metres past the fog end the camera still draws — a safety band for the fog's last few percent.
